name: Abbey Wood
notes: Elizabeth line terminus + FUNDED DLR-to-Thamesmead. Cheapest re-rating story on the line with a fresh catalyst on top.

name: Thamesmead
notes: Govt 'New Town' (15k homes, Peabody/Lendlease) + funded DLR. Cheapest riverside; weak transport TODAY (PTAL low) is the whole point - it's the leading bet.

name: Woolwich
notes: Elizabeth line open (uplift largely banked). Heavy Royal Arsenal new-build flat supply - cladding + oversupply risk; favour resale/houses.

name: Barking
notes: Cheapest borough. Barking Riverside (10k homes, Overground live). Top yield + FTB entry point.

name: Dagenham
notes: Cheapest house stock in London. Ex-LA stigma + slower transport; value play, lighter catalyst.

name: Manor Park
notes: Elizabeth line CATCH-UP: lagged early then ~11-17% of 10yr gain came recently. Period terraces, low cladding risk.

name: Forest Gate
notes: Genuine gentrification (outperformed Newham by ~9%). Victorian terraces, strong momentum, low structural risk.

name: Royal Docks
notes: 36k-home capacity, Elizabeth + DLR. But classic new-build flat glut - cladding/oversupply drag is real; be selective.

name: Walthamstow
notes: Established gentrification, Victoria line, Wetlands. Houses now above budget; flats fit. Catalyst largely priced - momentum play.

name: Leyton
notes: Walthamstow's cheaper neighbour, marshes, ripple-effect catch-up candidate.

name: Tottenham Hale
notes: Meridian Water (10k homes, new station, 20yr). Good momentum but heavy flat pipeline + Lea Valley flood/cladding watch.

name: Lewisham
notes: Zone 2, town-centre regen, mooted Bakerloo TERMINUS (long-dated). Solid all-rounder; Bakerloo is option value not base case.

name: Catford
notes: Cheaper Lewisham ripple. River Pool flood history. Quiet value play.

name: Croydon
notes: Cheap + high yield BUT Westfield regen is a perpetual-delay story (no application until mid-2026). Don't pay a regen premium that may never arrive.

name: Bexleyheath
notes: National rail only (no tube), good schools, safe, family houses sub-budget. Liveability/value, minimal growth catalyst.

name: Southall
notes: Elizabeth line open but uplift HELD BACK by huge Green Quarter (~3,750 homes) supply. Oversupply caps flat growth.

name: Canada Water
notes: British Land 53-acre scheme (~4,200 homes), Jubilee line, very central. Pricier (flats near budget ceiling), lower yield.

name: Old Kent Road
notes: £10-15bn / 20k homes regen. Bakerloo stations SAFEGUARDED but ~2040 - a 10-15yr option, not an imminent catalyst. Peckham-adjacent momentum.

name: Ealing
notes: Elizabeth line uplift LARGELY BANKED, weak recent momentum. Waitrose/M&S, great amenities - a 'priced-in / arrived' comparator.

name: Nine Elms
notes: Luxury-flat OVERSUPPLY case study: empty units, multi-year listings, price cuts, low yield. Included as a what-NOT-to-buy comparator.
